mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it triggers aggressive Fed tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in >60% of instances when PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, concurrent growth in HOUST and GDPC1 signals robust economic momentum that supports earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in <40% of late-cycle expansions when HOUST and GDPC1 both rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO indicates strong manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5d returns are positive in <40% of INDPRO growth instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE > 4.0% instances, or Rank IC negative over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recoveries, rising RSAFS signals strengthening consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur in <40% of post-recession recoveries when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signals monetary tightening causing economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
